Demo only. No account required. Saved on this device.

One campus. Many possibilities.

A campus map with a shared event layer: discover gatherings, drop a pin, open details, and RSVP.

  1. Explore: browse activity pins and filter by interest.
  2. Know exactly where: open a card for building, floor, room, host, time, and links.
  3. Contribute: pick a point, add exact room details, and post an activity.

This prototype uses a zoomable geographic map with street and satellite layers. Events, RSVPs, and reports are saved only in this browser. There is no shared database or verified login yet. A production version can use React + TypeScript, MapLibre, and Supabase for accounts, shared events, RSVP permissions, storage, and moderation. The crop follows the mapped Road Not Taken and upper Lover’s Lane, continues along connected hostel and sports roads, and closes around the cricket-ground edge. A small allowance keeps the boundary roads visible. This is a display crop, not a surveyed property boundary. Sample room details remain illustrative.

Campus shown: BITS Hyderabad, following the latest brief. The original concept mentioned IIT Hyderabad.
